counting_method: Page-aware extracted text bounded by printed headings and reconciled against all 23 rendered pages. PDF page 2 contents and PDF pages 22-23 references are excluded from the 20-page technical denominator; PDF page 1 Summary and PDF pages 3-21 body are included. Running headers, section headings, displayed equations, figure captions, reference entries, and bullet markers are excluded from prose counts while equations, figures, tables, and citations remain separately counted as content objects. Summary is a single continuous visual paragraph despite line wrapping. Introduction has six visual paragraphs, with its final paragraph continuing from PDF page 3 to PDF page 4.
ambiguities: The Summary sheet is one continuous paragraph; method, forecast, intervention, and conclusion moves are sentence-level units inside that paragraph rather than separate visual paragraphs.
The Introduction ends on PDF page 4 because its sixth paragraph continues across the page break before Section 2.

Model establishment has two source-separated segments: the basic EWR construction in Section 2.3 and the extended EWR balance in Section 2.5. They remain one functional chapter because the second explicitly repairs omissions in the first.

Section 2.4 is retained as robustness-verification because it compares EWR with WSI and then gives model strengths and weaknesses; its algebraic dependence is recorded later as a warning, not used to erase the positive evaluation-language pattern.
Case analysis covers the India rationale and driver diagnosis only; the current-state calculation begins the forecasting chapter.

Forecasting spans current-state reconstruction, the sector-growth stress model, the government-scenario polynomial model, computer assumptions, and citizen impacts because those parts form one forecast-to-consequence chain.
Intervention design ends before Section 5.2; surrounding-area externalities and Section 5.3 portfolio evaluation are kept as distinct functional chapters.
Results consists of Section 6 and its two full-page figures; the short millet sentence on PDF page 21 above Section 7 is included in the result segment.
References are source context rather than a positive prose chapter.
